full_title: Flurbiprofen Axetil Before Protamine to Prevent Clinically Important Hypotension in Adult Non-CABG On-Pump Cardiac Surgery: Protocol for the Multicentre, Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled IF-U-PLEASE II Trial
short_title: Flurbiprofen axetil before protamine in on-pump cardiac surgery
design: Multicentre, parallel-group, 1:1, superiority, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial
population: Adults undergoing elective non-CABG cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass, systemic unfractionated heparinisation, and planned protamine reversal
setting: Japan; participating sites to be confirmed before registration and submission

intervention.name: flurbiprofen axetil
intervention.description: Flurbiprofen axetil 50 mg (5 mL) administered intravenously over 5 minutes, with administration completed 15 ± 5 minutes before the start of protamine.

comparator.name: placebo
comparator.description: 0.9% sodium chloride 5 mL administered over 5 minutes on the same schedule, prepared in an opaque syringe and administered through opaque tubing.

protamine.t0_definition: Start of the first protamine infusion
protamine.dose_method: Site-standard residual-heparin titration is preferred. If unavailable, the initial dose is calculated from heparin exposure and elapsed time according to the locally approved label; the ratio must remain below 2.6 mg protamine per 100 units heparin.
protamine.infusion_method: Each 50 mg portion is diluted in 100–200 mL compatible fluid and infused over at least 10 minutes; all dose, rate, route, interruptions, additional doses, ACT values, and deviations are recorded.

primary_endpoint.name: Clinically important peri-protamine hypotension
primary_endpoint.definition: At least one artefact-free rolling 60-second epoch during 0–30 minutes after t=0 with median MAP at or below 80% of the stabilised pre-protamine baseline MAP.
primary_endpoint.baseline: Median of valid arterial-line MAP observations from 5 minutes to 1 minute before t=0.
primary_endpoint.capture: Arterial pressure waveform sampled at 1 Hz or faster; each qualifying epoch requires at least 45 valid seconds.

key_secondary_endpoints: Any artefact-free rolling 60-second epoch with MAP below 65 mmHg during 0–30 minutes
Continuous relative MAP reduction (PSI) from stabilised baseline to nadir during 0–30 minutes
Time-weighted average MAP below 65 mmHg and area under the 65-mmHg threshold during 0–30 minutes
New vasopressor bolus, increase in vasoactive infusion, or rescue mechanical support during 0–30 minutes
Composite of the primary MAP criterion or protocol-defined haemodynamic rescue during 0–30 minutes
Peak mean pulmonary artery pressure and pulmonary hypertensive reaction where a pulmonary artery catheter is clinically present
KDIGO acute kidney injury through postoperative day 7 or discharge, whichever occurs first
Chest-tube drainage, transfusion, reoperation for bleeding, gastrointestinal bleeding, myocardial infarction, stroke, serious adverse events, and death

strata: preoperative exposure to protamine-containing insulin or documented prior protamine exposure (yes/no)

sample_size.rationale: The planning control risk is anchored to a published 12.9% rate of adverse events within 30 minutes of protamine after cardiopulmonary bypass, rather than the retrospective study's confounded 17% estimate. The assumed 6% treatment risk is deliberately less extreme than the retrospective zero-event observation.

analysis.estimand: Treatment-policy difference in 30-minute risk of clinically important peri-protamine hypotension
analysis.primary_method: Marginal risk difference from a logistic regression model adjusted for the randomisation stratification variables and baseline MAP, estimated by standardisation with a 95% confidence interval from 2,000 stratified bootstrap samples.
analysis.supportive_effects: Unadjusted risk difference, risk ratio, and odds ratio with 95% confidence intervals
analysis.sparse_event_method: Firth penalised logistic regression for the adjusted odds ratio if complete or quasi-complete separation occurs
analysis.continuous_method: ANCOVA or linear regression adjusted for baseline MAP and randomisation strata; robust standard errors are used if residual assumptions are not met
